description: This file defines the Weight class within the Opencart system library for managing weight-related operations such as conversion, formatting, and retrieving weight units. It interacts with database tables to load weight class data and provides methods for conversions and data formatting.

classes.name: Weight
classes.description: A class that manages weight data, conversions, formatting, and retrieval of weight units within the Opencart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Weight object by loading weight class data from the database using the registry provided.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a weight value from one weight class to another based on predefined conversion rates.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a weight value into a string with appropriate units, decimal, and thousand separators.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Returns the unit symbol for a specified weight class.
